facts.text: Annie drops Lindsey at Laurie's, then heads off.
facts.why: Annie walks Lindsey across the street to the Doyle house, where Laurie is babysitting Tommy. Laurie's own house is not involved.
facts.fix: Annie drops Lindsey at the Doyle house, then heads off.

facts.text: I'm babysitting Tommy tonight. We're carving the pumpkin, and I just want one quiet night.
